metadata.name: Cancer Survivor (personal history of cancer)

sources.citation: Difference in excess late mortality between early-onset and late-onset cancer survivors: a nationwide cross-sectional study (PMC12430759). Late-onset survivors SMR 1.59 (95% CI 1.37-1.84); early-onset SMR 2.07 (1.76-2.44)

metadata.description: A personal history of cancer carries excess all-cause mortality vs the general population (late recurrence, second cancers, treatment cardiotoxicity). Modeled at the late-onset survivor estimate; early-onset and recently diagnosed survivors are higher (AYA SMR up to 7-12 in the first decade).
